acquisition method: mass spectrometric analysis was performed in data-dependent scan mode.
alkylation reagent: Next, iodoacetamide was added for alkylation (final concentration of 15 mM)
alkylation concentration: Next, iodoacetamide was added for alkylation (final concentration of 15 mM)
cleavage agent: Tryptic digestion was performed at 37 °C overnight (16 hours) at a 1:50 (w/w) trypsin-to-protein ratio.
collision energy: MS/MS fragments were generated with a 27% normalized collision energy, an isolation window of 2.2 m/z and a fixed first mass of 130 m/z.
fragmentation method: The 10 ions with the highest intensities were selected for higher energy collision-induced dissociation (HCD) fragmentation.
instrument: coupled on-line to a quadrupole orbitrap mass spectrometer (Q Exactive, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
ionization type: Ionization took place in a nano electrospray ionization source (ESI)
labeling: Cerebrospinal fluid from a longitudinal study group including 12 healthy control subjects was analyzed by label-free quantification (LFQ) via LC-MS/MS.
reduction reagent: Proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration) at 60 °C for 30 min.
reduction concentration: Proteins were reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol (final concentration) at 60 °C for 30 min.
